question: Is the RXJ1347 preference for outward radial flux remapping shared by other raw strong-lens systems, or is the sign system-dependent?
formula: Use the unchanged 49-setting radial-remap grid and P0554 parent from the prior frozen protocol; select no new setting from this raw diagnostic.

geometry.source: archived lensing_softness_098 geometry from P0554 route-softness interaction
geometry.source_positions: profiled on each candidate's training images
geometry.heldout: exact lens-equation roots at the pre-existing predictive split

comparison.accuracy: compare candidate and parent only on systems where both recover every held-out root
comparison.topology: report root creation and loss separately
comparison.aggregate: equal-system RMS across matched complete systems
comparison.selection_history: f001_l080 was frozen by galaxy plus derived-cluster discovery scores before any RXJ1347 or these five-system raw scores

claim_limits: All five systems and their P0554 geometries are spent exploratory evidence.
Holding ordinary geometry fixed isolates formula sensitivity but is not a new optimized fit.
The baryonic input is a sparse spherical profile and omits a registered two-dimensional gas and ICL map.
An exact-root loss is a topology failure and is never counted as an accuracy improvement.
This diagnoses a radial weak-field operator and does not validate a covariant gravity theory.
